author: rememes
body:
I was told that excessive infractions ban is 22 infractions
I have 21 valid infractions because one of them isnt a infraction and the other one is fixing a glitched one.
Also most of them are pretty stupid.
If you look almost all my infractions a decent amount of them are by people who have been demoted.
Seems like a bit of a pattern,
Either way hopefully i can be appealed
Rem

title: My appeal for excessive infractions

replies.author: BoldAndBrash
replies.body:
Hello,

We have new guidelines that say 15+ infractions within 8 months warrants a 30 day ban. Also, the infraction I combined with your excessive infractions tempban was "rudeness." We were sent evidence of you being very disrespectful towards another player. I look forward to seeing your reply, :)
